adjudication.rationale: The migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` builds an INSERT statement via string interpolation: `VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)` where `h` comes from the existing `site_settings` value `embeddable_hosts` split by newlines. If any saved host line contains a single quote, the SQL becomes syntactically invalid and the migration will fail. It also establishes an SQL-injection-by-stored-setting-value pattern (even if typically admin-controlled), since the value is not quoted/escaped via the DB connection.
